primary_questions: Does acquiring the relevant local tool convention accelerate an unfamiliar composition compared with equal-budget unrelated training and a fresh learner?
Does a 64-example fixed-total replay buffer preserve executable primitive skills under independently varied tool conventions and task-family orders?
Does Agent-Dice coordinate filtering improve over ordinary averaging of the same independently trained experts?

sandbox.state: in-memory deterministic JSON data; no filesystem, network, exec, eval, or arbitrary code execution
sandbox.target: three-operation workflows, with two additional operation combinations held out from all target training

scoring.primary: natural chat EOS, one strict JSON array, executable calls, and exact full final sandbox state
scoring.json_whitespace_and_object_key_order: standard JSON accepted; no string stripping or substring extraction
scoring.semantically_equivalent_call_sequences: accepted if full state is exact and all calls are valid

qualification.already_competent_baseline: Require at least 0.15 headroom and a measured gain even for an initially competent model. Raw primitive and target-workflow validation baselines are measured before training; saturation stops before training and triggers a separate train/dev redesign.
qualification.selection: first shared update budget where every expert qualifies; all experts reach that same budget
qualification.failure: save checkpoints and train/validation format-versus-execution diagnostics; execute zero stream, fusion, or workflow comparisons; parent designs a separate prerequisite experiment if needed

sequential_controls.initial_fork: same first qualified expert weights and optimizer state
sequential_controls.memory: 64 unique previously exposed TRAIN examples total, updated at stage boundaries
sequential_controls.replay: replace two of four current examples, preserving total updates and example exposures; new/old exposures differ and are reported
sequential_controls.eligibility: current family must qualify after its stage before any later stage or workflow transfer in that arm
sequential_controls.memory_metadata: One stream counter plus the four-family completion set; no retained unbounded index of old example IDs. Admission deduplicates current-stage exposed rows transiently.

fusion_controls.source_experts: exact same four independently qualified LoRA experts with a common base and identical initial factor seed
fusion_controls.logical_training_updates_each: four times the shared qualification budget, fully counted even when experts reused by controls
fusion_controls.formula: fuse effective dense scaled B@A deltas, then add to original base
fusion_controls.storage: four archived rank-eight experts plus one dense fused offset; explicitly not fixed-memory sequential learning
fusion_controls.capacity: both fusions have identical dense allocation, with theoretical rank bounds reported and numerical rank not inferred
fusion_controls.hybrid_with_replay: not included in this first method-alone comparison
fusion_controls.trainable_factors_during_transfer: Both dense fusions use the original shared A initialization and zero B. No privileged factor initialization from the first specialist.

transfer_controls.source_pretraining: relevant and irrelevant each get one equally trained expert; fresh has zero history; sequential and fused histories represent four families, separately reported
transfer_controls.matched_target_training: all conditions receive the same ordered TRAIN row IDs, 128 updates, 512 example exposures, and fresh AdamW state
transfer_controls.measurements: zero-shot and 16/64/128 update validation curves; final test and separate unseen-combination test
transfer_controls.primary: relevant versus irrelevant normalized validation AUC, with fresh reference; Agent-Dice versus arithmetic separately
transfer_controls.prerequisite_vs_outcome: workflow success is measured only after primitives qualify; failure to compose is retained as a result, not treated as evidence of generic learning failure

integrity: exclusive output directory and JSON writes
exact corpus identity and no repeated scene/prompt across splits
complete native generated-answer evaluation for all gates
exact checkpoint tensors and optimizer roundtrip
full generation equality after deliberate adapter perturbation and reload in same process
cached/uncached full output equality before and after primitive training
raw generated token IDs and semantic execution traces
scope: synthetic deterministic tools with meaningful execution, not ToolAlpaca or real external-tool performance
four independent streams; same optimization seed
dense expert fusion and replay have different state budgets
same-process behavioral reload only; separate-process GPU reconstruction remains an additional audit
argument type schemas may reveal operation identity despite opaque names; measured raw and irrelevant-history controls are essential
requests explicitly state operations and order: tests composition of known calls, not autonomous subgoal discovery

numerical_path.native_fp32_base_components: allowed; all parameter and buffer dtype counts recorded
numerical_path.device: cuda:0 within exactly one visible ROCm GPU
numerical_path.finiteness: check all floating parameters/buffers after loading; validate checkpoint factors/offsets before restore and adapter parameters after every optimizer update
numerical_path.qualification: Archived followthrough-20260912-qualify-qwen35-4b source explicitly loaded BF16. This lane preserves that requested dtype. The qualification does not establish behavior of this custom learner.

snapshot_identity.expected_content_binding: All ten existing cached-file digests independently cross-checked against Hub revision 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a using LFS SHA256 for large files and fetched git-blob-checked small files.
snapshot_identity.runtime: Verify size and streamed SHA256 for all required files before model loading; separately verify tokenizer inputs before tokenizer loading. Reject unknown entries except named nonloading documents and .cache metadata. Check file identity remained unchanged during hash/load.
